35724.title: Risk Perceptions of E-Cigarettes and the Evaluation of EVALI Messaging
35724.zh_title: 电子烟风险认知与EVALI信息传播效果评估
35724.authors: Lawrence Jin, Donald S. Kenkel, Alan D. Mathios, Grace N. Phillips, Revathy Suryanarayana, Hua Wang
35724.zh_abstract_excerpt: 随着电子烟及其他替代尼古丁产品销售的增长，政府面临新的挑战：如何制定公共卫生信息，向消费者传达这些风险较低但并非无风险的产品信息。贝叶斯学习构成了我们分析吸烟者如何基于吸烟风险形成对电子烟风险认知的理论框架。本文由两部分组成。首先，我们对政府信息传播和吸烟者对电子烟风险的认知进行了跨国描述性分析。我们研究了八个不同的国家：澳大利亚、中国、印度尼西亚、日本、马来西亚、瑞典、英国和美国。我们发现各国的公共卫生信息差异很大。
35724.abstract: With the growth of sales of e-cigarettes and other alternative nicotine products, governments face the new challenge of crafting public health messages that provide information to consumers about these less risky but not risk-free products. Bayesian learning serves as the theoretical framework for our analysis of how smokers form their perceptions of the risks of e-cigarettes based on the risks of smoking. This paper consists of two parts. First, we conduct a cross-country descriptive analysis of government messaging and smokers’ perceptions of e-cigarette risks. We study a diverse group of eight countries: Australia, China, Indonesia, Japan, Malaysia, Sweden, the U.K. and the U.S. We find that public health messages range widely across the countries. In online cross-country surveys of adult smokers, on average perceptions of e-cigarette risks are associated with their perceptions of the risk of smoking and with their countries’ messaging. Notably, in all eight countries many smokers incorrectly believe that e-cigarettes are relatively more harmful than smoking and over-estimate the absolute risks of e-cigarettes. In the second part of our study, we report the results of online randomized experiments that compare the effects of different e-cigarette risk messaging about an outbreak of lung injuries (given the acronym EVALI). The U.K. public health message about the low risk of e-cigarettes relative to smoking reduced smokers’ incorrect risk perceptions, while the U.S. public health message increased incorrect risk perceptions.

35723.title: An Empirically-Grounded Theory of Voting Based on Prosocial Motives
35723.zh_title: 基于亲社会动机的投票行为经验驱动理论
35723.authors: Dan M. Bernhardt, Laurent Bouton, Stefan Krasa, Francesco Squintani
35723.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们提出了一个在经典空间设置中的高成本投票模型，该模型调和了选举投票率的关键经验特征。我们整合了具有亲社会投票动机的公民，当（i）他们预期更多支持者会投票，（ii）这些投票对获胜概率的集体影响更大，以及（iii）他们更关心哪个候选人获胜时，他们从投票中获得的效用更高。我们证明了满足附加条件的纳什均衡的存在性，该条件确保均衡对应于具有许多选民的有限设置中的均衡。
35723.abstract: We propose a model of costly voting in a canonical spatial setting that reconciles key empirical features of electoral turnout. We integrate citizens with prosocial voting motives who realize higher payoffs from voting when (i) they expect more fellow supporters to vote, (ii) such votes collectively matter more for winning probabilities, and (iii) they care more about which candidate wins. We establish existence of Nash equilibria satisfying an additional condition that ensures equilibria correspond to those in a finite setting with many voters. We derive how electoral primitives—e.g., voter ideology, voting costs, elite polarization, expected closeness—affect outcomes such as turnout, turnout rates, and winning margins. We relate the predictions to empirical findings both from existing studies and our original data work. With all three prosocial motive components, our model reconciles the empirical regularities qualitatively and quantitatively; while existing models fail on multiple dimensions.

35722.title: The Multigenerational Effects of Legal Access to the Pill on Infant Health
35722.zh_title: 未成年人合法获取避孕药的多代际效应对婴儿健康的影响
35722.authors: Hamid Noghanibehambari, David Slusky, Erdal Tekin, Hoa Vu
35722.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们考察了扩大未成年人合法获取避孕药的范围是否为后代带来了健康益处。我们使用了1970年至2020年限制使用的出生登记数据，将母亲与其出生所在州和年份的避孕药获取水平以及其母亲在未成年时获取避孕药的程度联系起来。我们的结果表明，母亲在未成年时扩大获取避孕药后出生的孩子有更好的出生结局，其中收益集中在黑人家庭。在受影响的出生中，合法化使出生体重增加了12-16克，并将低出生体重发生率降低了2.7-3.4%。
35722.abstract: We examine whether expanded legal access to the contraceptive pill for minors generated health benefits for subsequent generations. We use data from the restricted-use Natality files from 1970-2020, linking mothers to the level of access to the pill in their state and year of birth and the extent to which their mothers could access the pill as minors. Our results show that children whose mothers were born after expanded access to the pill as minors had better birth outcomes, with gains concentrated among Black families. Among affected births, legalization increased birth weight by 12-16 grams and reduced incidence of low birth weight by 2.7-3.4 percent. These magnitudes have economic significance, corresponding to approximately $113.8–$115.3 million in medical cost savings, measured in 2025 dollars, for the 2000 Black birth cohort alone. Our mechanism analysis points to a postponement of early childbearing by the generation directly affected by legal access to the pill as minors whose daughters subsequently attained higher levels of education, used more prenatal care, and had longer birth spacing. Taken together, our results suggest that reproductive health policy can generate multigenerational benefits and contribute to reductions in racial disparities in early-life health.

35721.title: Politics-driven Market Access and Its Cost: Evidence from China’s Grand Canal

35721.authors: Ying Bai, Xiaoyu Bian, Ruixue Jia
35721.zh_abstract_excerpt: 交通网络通常从国家首都向外辐射，反映了政治优先事项与经济逻辑同等重要。为政治而非市场而建的基础设施代价有多大？我们研究了中国的大运河：当蒙古人将首都从中原迁往北京时，运河也随之改道，绕过了它曾经服务的经济核心。使用跨越五个朝代（8世纪至19世纪）的网格-年份面板数据，我们表明最适合到达首都的路线预测了运河的实际路径。这种重新设计重塑了市场准入，并通过市场准入影响了人口。反事实分析表明，运河使人口增加了2.5-6.
35721.abstract: Transportation networks often radiate from national capitals, reflecting political priorities as much as economic logic. How costly is infrastructure built for politics rather than markets? We study China’s Grand Canal: when the Mongols moved the capital from the central plain to Beijing, the canal followed, bypassing the economic core it once served. Using a grid-year panel spanning five dynasties (8th–19th centuries), we show the route best suited to reach the capital predicts the canal’s actual path. This redesign reshaped market access and, through it, population. Counterfactual analysis shows the canal raised population by 2.5–6.1%, but its politically motivated redesign cost 1.1–2.2%.

35720.abstract: Whether AI assistance builds or erodes professional expertise is unsettled. In a pre-registered three-month randomized controlled trial, we gave 133 practicing patent lawyers at eleven U.S. intellectual property law firms access to a custom AI drafting assistant and measured both their performance while using AI and their professional judgment afterward without it. All work was scored by blinded expert patent attorneys. Paralleling findings from other white-collar domains, AI access raised the quality of work delivered on benchmark patent drafting tasks at 10 days (0.34 SD, p = 0.03) and 90 days (0.38 SD, p = 0.01), with larger gains among junior lawyers. After three months, all subjects redlined an existing patent application without AI, a core task of patent practice requiring expert judgment. Treated lawyers outperformed controls by 0.32 SD (p = 0.04), but this advantage was concentrated entirely among senior lawyers (0.45 SD, p = 0.02). Junior lawyers showed no average gain; their scores instead bifurcated, with sharply fewer mediocre scores offset by more poor and more good ones. The largest gains from AI thus accrued to the lawyers who retained the least. Foundational expertise may be a prerequisite for extracting durable skill from AI-assisted practice.

35719.title: The Utility of AI Tools in Auditing Adherence to Pre-Analysis Plans
35719.zh_title: AI工具在审计预分析计划遵守情况中的效用
35719.zh_abstract_excerpt: 预分析计划（PAPs）可以通过减少研究者的自由度来提高研究的可重复性，但其价值取决于遵守情况。我们认为，大型语言模型（LLMs）可以为作者和审稿人提供一种高效、可扩展且系统化的方式来评估对PAPs的遵守情况。在应用于我们自己的研究时，LLM系统地识别预先承诺的设计选择，评估偏差，并诊断预指定中的空白，大大减少了这些任务所需的人力。然而，不同LLM之间审计输出的差异性强调了人类判断持续的重要性。我们讨论了对AI辅助PAP审计最佳实践的影响。
35719.abstract: Pre-analysis plans (PAPs) can improve research reproducibility by reducing researchers’ degrees of freedom, but their value depends on adherence. We argue that large language models (LLMs) can provide an efficient, scalable, and systematic way for authors and reviewers to assess adherence to PAPs. In an application to our own research, an LLM systematically identifies precommitted design choices, evaluates deviations, and diagnoses gaps in pre-specification, substantially reducing the human labor required for these tasks. However, variability in audit output across LLMs underscores the continued importance of human judgment. We discuss implications for best practices in AI-assisted PAP auditing.

35718.title: Will New Transportation Technologies Increase Urban Density
35718.zh_title: 新交通技术是否会提高城市密度
35718.zh_abstract_excerpt: 21世纪的交通创新是会像20世纪的汽车那样削弱城市密度，还是会像19世纪的铁路那样促进城市中心化？在经典的Alonso-Muth-Mills模型中，降低通勤成本总是会削弱城市中心化，但如果出行次数是内生的，且出行次数对其成本的弹性大于1，这一结论就会反转。随着日常出行中非必需出行的比例似乎越来越高，且城市中心越来越多地提供娱乐活动，这一弹性可能随时间推移而增大。
35718.abstract: Will 21st century transportation innovations work against urban density, as the car did in the 20th century, or promote urban centralization, as the railroad did in the 19th century? Reducing the cost of commuting always reduces urban centralization in the classic Alonso-Muth-Mills model but that result reverses if the number of trips is endogenous and the elasticity of trips with respect to their costs is greater than one. That elasticity may have increased over time, as an increasing share of daily trips seems to be discretionary and city centers increasingly provide entertainment. This paper asks discusses the urbanizing effects of four trends in transportation technology: shared mobility (such as Uber), autonomy (such as Waymo), vertical travel and green mobility, as provided by bike lane. As people spend more time travelling in denser, large areas, innovations that reduce the time cost of travel, such as autonomous cars, seem likely to complement urban living, as long as they don’t excessively increase traffic. Sharing is also easier in big cities, so technologies that involve sharing are also centripetal. The other trends seem less likely to have major effects. Moreover, the forces of inertia, which include both regulation and legacy infrastructure, are likely to limit the impact of any new technologies in Europe and the U.S., so that the biggest changes in urban form are likely to appear in east Asia and the developing world.

35717.title: The No Surprises Act’s Surprises: Arbitration, Provider Network, and Insurer Pricing
35717.zh_title: 《无意外法案》的意外后果：仲裁、提供者网络与保险公司定价
35717.authors: Panle Jia Barwick, Anran Li, Tianli Xia, Shizhe Yu
35717.zh_abstract_excerpt: 《无意外法案》（NSA）限制了患者对意外账单的责任，并建立了联邦最终报价仲裁机制来解决保险公司与医疗服务提供者之间的支付纠纷。通过将仲裁记录与全国纵向的提供者-保险公司网络面板数据以及ACA市场的计划设计数据相连接，我们发现，NSA降低了受该改革影响最大的专科和州的提供者网络参与度，这与“取消余额账单会使网络参与更具吸引力”的标准预测相反。这一下降与仲裁增强了提供者的外部选择权相一致：仲裁量大且偏向提供者，裁决金额远高于法定基准；
35717.abstract: The No Surprises Act (NSA) capped patients' liability for surprise bills and established federal final-offer arbitration for insurer–provider payment disputes. Linking arbitration records to the national longitudinal provider-insurer network panel and plan design data in the ACA marketplace, we find that the NSA reduced provider network participation in the specialties and states most affected by the reform, contrary to the standard prediction that removing balance billing makes network participation more attractive. The decline is consistent with arbitration strengthening providers' outside option: arbitration is high-volume and provider-favorable, with awards well above the statutory benchmark; and network participation declines after provider groups' first favorable arbitration outcomes. Suggestive evidence indicates that insurers more exposed to arbitration raise premiums. These results reveal an unintended consequence of the NSA: the law's direct consumer protections may be accompanied by narrower networks and higher premiums.

35715.title: Fiscal Policy and the Saving Glut of the Rich

Funded transfers, by contrast, are financed through future taxes borne primarily by high-income households, which respond by accumulating claims on both households and the government. Using a structurally estimated version of the model, we find that the shift from unfunded to funded redistribution in the 1980s contributed significantly to the subsequent saving glut of the rich.

35714.title: Behavioral Signatures of Cognitive Noise
35714.zh_abstract_excerpt: 认知噪声假说越来越成为解释人类行为中各种令人费解的规律性的流行理论。利用简单、熟悉的工具和源自神经科学的最小假设，认知噪声模型为行为经济学中记录的最重要的一些异常现象提供了简洁、统一的解释。该假说提出，有限的认知资源迫使大脑不精确地表征信息，从而导致更粗糙的决策、随机行为和主观不确定性。由于大脑以大致贝叶斯的方式处理这种不精确性，不精确性会导致许多众所周知的、且在这种不精确性下可能实际上是最优的行为偏差。
35714.abstract: The cognitive noise hypothesis is an increasingly popular explanation for a wide range of puzzling regularities in human behavior. Using simple, familiar tools and minimal assumptions drawn from neuroscience, cognitive noise models provide a parsimonious, unified explanation for a number of the most important anomalies documented in behavioral economics. The hypothesis proposes that limited cognitive resources force the brain to represent information imprecisely, generating coarser decisions, stochastic behavior and subjective uncertainty. Because brains deal with this kind of imprecision in a broadly Bayesian manner, imprecision leads to a number of well-known behavioral biases that may in fact be optimal given that imprecision. Because brains also allocate scarce cognitive resources adaptively, these biases and their severity are impacted by seemingly-irrelevant aspects of the choice environment, providing an explanation for a number of well-known context and experience effects that are otherwise difficult to explain. We review the basic structure of these models, their behavioral consequences, and the growing body of empirical evidence supporting them.

35713.title: Rust in Motion: The Political Environmental Trap of Vehicle Tax Exemptions

35713.authors: Gabriel Facundes Monteiro, Edson R. Severnini
35713.zh_abstract_excerpt: 交通运输是全球温室气体和空气污染的主要来源之一，而大部分汽车污染来自车龄超过10年的车辆。然而，许多政策不鼓励老旧车辆退出车队，这可能对污染和公共健康产生影响。本文利用巴西一项基于公平动机的反报废政策，采用边界配对设计，利用各州车辆保有税豁免年龄门槛的差异。利用2013-2020年市级车辆登记数据，我们发现，较低的豁免年龄门槛会使平均车队车龄增加最多一年，因为这鼓励车主保留车辆直至其符合税收豁免资格。
35713.abstract: Transportation is a major source of greenhouse gas and air pollution emissions worldwide, with most automobile pollution coming from vehicles older than 10 years. Yet, many policies discourage the removal of older vehicles from the fleet, with potential consequences for pollution and public health. Using municipality-level vehicle registration data from 2013-2020, we find that lower exemption age thresholds increase the average fleet age by up to one year, as they encourage owners to retain vehicles until they qualify for tax exemptions. 35709.authors: Shuaizhang Feng, Lars Lefgren, Jieyi Liu, Brennan Platt, Xiaoyu Xia
35709.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究了具有职业阶梯的劳动力市场中的年龄歧视，其中工人生产率随时间推移而显现。利用来自中国大型招聘平台的数据（该平台将职位发布、申请和雇主回应联系起来），我们记录了在公布的年龄截止点处申请和回电的急剧下降。歧视在两个方向上都起作用：年长申请者在入门级工作中处于劣势，而年轻申请者被聘用到管理岗位的可能性较低。一个具有不完美信号筛选的统计歧视模型解释了这些模式。与该模型一致，申请入门级工作的年长申请者相对于其同龄人存在负向选择。

35708.title: “Non-Marginal” Investor Beliefs

35708.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本文提供了关于退出市场的投资者（即“非边际”投资者）的信念如何影响资产价格的证据。利用超过二十年的受访者层面投资者调查，我们构建了楔形指标，用以量化主观投资者信念与期权隐含基准之间的距离。我们使用自我识别的市场参与代理变量来记录这些楔形与非边际投资者信念的对应关系。非边际投资者通常在其市场回报预测上更为悲观，并且比定价人群感知到更大的崩盘风险。主观崩盘信念是参与度的关键决定因素，即使在控制预期回报信念时也是如此。

This heterogeneity, in part, explains the negative association between average expected returns estimated from surveys and future realized market returns. Taken together, the results provide evidence of a composition channel in which belief-driven exit concentrates risk among fewer investors.

35707.title: Dynamic Investment and Product Market Rivalry: the Network Q Model

35707.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们提出了一个在不完全竞争产品市场中企业投资的新动态模型，该模型扩展了新古典资本（Q）理论，以适应异质性的多产品企业和丰富的享乐需求系统。我们的模型内生化了企业的加成率，并将托宾Q推广为产品市场溢出效应的矩阵（或网络），该矩阵捕捉了每个企业的投资如何影响其竞争对手的投资。我们提供了均衡存在性和唯一性结果，以及企业投资策略的全局解析解。
35707.abstract: We present a new dynamic model of corporate investment in imperfectly competitive product markets that extends the neoclassical (Q) theory of capital to accommodate heterogeneous, multi-product firms and a rich hedonic demand system. Our model endogenizes firms' markups and generalizes Tobin's Q to a matrix (or network) of product market spillovers, which captures how each firm's investment affects that of its rivals. We provide equilibrium existence and uniqueness results along with global analytical solutions for the firms' investment policies. We then take our model to the data for the universe of US public companies and obtain four novel insights: 1) product market competition is a key driver of aggregate investment and capital allocation; 2) shocks to firms' cost of capital generate highly heterogeneous investment and markup responses across firms, and thus impact industry concentration; 3) monopoly rents account for a large, rising share of firms' value; 4) mergers consummated since 1995 have led to a modest decline in the aggregate capital formation of merging firms, yet firm-level markup increases have been highly heterogeneous.

35706.title: Meetings
35706.authors: David J. Deming, Katrine V. Løken, Alexander Willén, Yaling Xu
35706.zh_abstract_excerpt: 为什么我们有这么多会议？很少有职场特征如此受人诟病，却又看似必不可少。本文利用一项针对超过9,000名工人的原始调查，并将其与挪威匹配的雇主-雇员行政数据相关联，提供了关于职场会议的首个大规模经济学证据。我们表明，会议既普遍又代价高昂，平均消耗了12%的工作时间和14%的企业工资总额。规划、问题解决、信息共享和项目协调构成了会议活动的主体。高薪和高收入企业在会议上投入更多资源，尽管它们面临着显著更高的员工时间机会成本。
35706.abstract: Why do we have so many meetings? Few workplace features are so scorned, yet seemingly so necessary. This paper provides the first large-scale economic evidence on workplace meetings using an original survey of more than 9,000 workers linked to matched employer–employee administrative data from Norway. We show that meetings are both common and costly, consuming an average of 12 percent of work hours and 14 percent of firm wage bills. Planning, problem solving, information sharing, and project coordination account for the majority of meeting activity. High-paying and high-revenue firms devote more resources to meetings despite facing a substantially higher opportunity cost of employee time. Meeting frequency and intensity are positively related to worker wage growth. Workers in meeting-intensive firms report greater on-the-job learning, and interactions with more senior colleagues are associated with stronger wage growth, suggesting that knowledge transmission within firms is an important mechanism. Meetings are the broccoli of work – widely disliked, but probably good for us anyway.

35705.title: Unemployment Insurance in Macroeconomic Stabilization with Imperfect Expectations
35705.zh_title: 不完全预期下宏观经济稳定中的失业保险
35705.zh_abstract_excerpt: 自动稳定器可以在无需新政策决策的情况下应对衰退，但其对总需求的影响可能仍会延迟显现。我们研究了一个异质性代理人新凯恩斯模型中失业保险延长的传导时滞，该模型紧密匹配了失业风险的分布以及家庭支出对失业和失业保险延长的反应。更慷慨的失业保险主要通过放松预防性储蓄来刺激需求，因此家庭必须预期未来的失业风险和福利持续时间。为了量化这一渠道，我们直接使用调查预期，利用预测误差和修正的实测历史，而不是依赖于特定的信念形成模型。
35705.abstract: Automatic stabilizers can respond to a recession without a new policy decision, but their effects on aggregate demand may still only arrive with delay. We study the transmission lag for unemployment insurance extensions in a heterogeneous-agent New Keynesian model that closely matches the incidence of unemployment risk and the response of household spending to job loss and UI extensions. More generous UI stimulates demand largely by relaxing precautionary saving, so households must anticipate future unemployment risk and benefit duration. To quantify this channel, we work directly with survey expectations, using a measured history of forecast errors and revisions, rather than committing to a specific model of belief formation. Our estimated model implies a significant Expectations-Driven Efficacy Lag. The direct effect of UI extensions on consumption peaks only after UI duration has begun to recede. In general equilibrium, the consumption multiplier is about 0.6 on impact, about half its value under full-information rational expectations, but the policy becomes more effective by the end of the first year of the recession.

35704.title: The Allocative Cost of War: A View to a Kill...ing of Productivity
35704.zh_title: 战争的配置成本：生产率之殇
35704.authors: Marvin Amann, Yuriy Gorodnichenko, Oleksandr Talavera
35704.zh_abstract_excerpt: 为什么战争的经济代价如此高昂？我们的答案是，现代战争不仅通过摧毁生产要素来降低产出，还使幸存的经济体运行效率降低。利用2022年俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰期间收集的独特且全面的企业层面数据，我们记录了乌克兰配置生产率的急剧崩溃。为了加强识别并探索关键机制（包括战争强度、国内流离失所、重新配置和宏观经济不稳定的作用），我们利用了乌克兰各地区间的空间异质性，并与2014年俄罗斯的侵略和2008年全球金融危机进行了比较。
35704.abstract: Why is war so economically costly? Our answer is that modern war lowers output not only by destroying productive factors, but also by making the surviving economy work less efficiently. Using uniquely comprehensive firm-level data collected during Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022, we document a dramatic collapse in allocative productivity in Ukraine. To sharpen identification and explore key mechanisms (including the role of war intensity, internal displacement, reallocation, and macroeconomic instability), we exploit spatial heterogeneity across Ukrainian districts and comparisons with Russian aggression in 2014 and the 2008 Global Financial Crisis. Our key policy implication is that restoring allocative efficiency–and preparing institutional arrangements that facilitate rapid reallocation in times of stress–is critical for sustaining economic capacity, defense, and national security.

35703.title: How Big is Small? The Economic Effects of Access to Small Business Government Support
35703.zh_title: 小企业有多大？获得小企业政府支持的经济效应
35703.authors: J. David Brown, Matthew Denes, Ran Duchin, John Hackney
35703.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究了美国小企业计划资格标准的大幅提高的影响，这些提高扩大了大企业获得小企业支持的渠道。利用这些扩张时间上的准随机变化，并使用行政人口普查数据，我们表明最小企业的收入下降，尤其是那些更年轻、生产率更高且财务受限的企业。政府采购合同也被重新分配给较大的企业。因此，企业退出增加，工资下降，专利申请减少。这些发现凸显了扩大资格的经济后果：通过挤出最小企业，资源从高潜力企业转移，从而降低了活力和创新。

These findings highlight the economic consequences of expanding eligibility: by crowding out the smallest firms, resources shift away from high-potential firms, reducing dynamism and innovation.

35702.title: Rational Inattention to Discrete Choices with Stable Priors
35702.zh_title: 具有稳定先验的离散选择的理性疏忽
35702.zh_abstract_excerpt: 先验信息如何影响离散选择？在Matějka和McKay (2015)的开创性理性疏忽模型中，多项式Logit模型源于对选择收益不确定且能够使用灵活信息获取技术的代理人的离散选择（RI-logit）。这个强大框架的一个关键局限性是缺乏已知的解决方案，无法让决策者的先验信息在不同选择之间变化：获得此类解决方案在该文献中一直是一个未解决的问题。
35702.abstract: How does prior information affect discrete choice? In the seminal rational inattention model of Matějka and McKay (2015), multinomial logit arises from the discrete choice of agents who are uncertain about choice payoffs and who have access to a flexible information acquisition technology (RI-logit). A key limitation of this powerful framework is the lack of known solutions that allow the decision maker's prior information to vary across choices: obtaining such solutions has remained an open problem in this literature. In this paper, I solve the RI-logit model analytically for two related families of priors known respectively as Positive Stable and Tempered Stable distributions. In my solution, the decision maker's prior information enters the choice probabilities through a choice-specific parameter, which can be read as shifting either the ex-ante expected utility of a risk-neutral decision maker, or the ex-ante riskiness perceived by a risk-averse one. These results complete the RI-logit framework by separating prior information from information that is endogenously acquired, and expand its empirical applications by making it possible to study how choice probabilities react to changes in prior information.

35701.title: Tracking Inequality: Teachers and the Allocation of Educational Opportunities
35701.zh_title: 追踪不平等：教师与教育机会的分配
35701.authors: Michela Carlana, Francesca Miserocchi, Eleonora Patacchini
35701.zh_abstract_excerpt: 专业人士经常为他人做出影响深远的决定，却没有系统地观察这些决定的结果。这些决定是反映了准确的预测，还是反映了系统性扭曲的信念，对机会平等具有重要意义。我们结合全国范围的行政数据、随机小插曲实验、信念诱导和实地实验，在教师对高中分流的推荐背景下研究这个问题。在控制学生的学业成绩和兴趣的情况下，当学生来自弱势的社会经济背景时，教师推荐要求严格的学术轨道的可能性显著降低。
35701.abstract: Professionals routinely make consequential decisions for others without systematically observing how those decisions turn out. Whether such decisions reflect accurate forecasting or systematically distorted beliefs has important implications for equality of opportunity. We study this question in the context of teachers' recommendations for high school tracks by combining nationwide administrative data, randomized vignette experiments, belief elicitation, and a field experiment. Holding students' academic performance and interests constant, teachers are significantly less likely to recommend demanding academic tracks when students come from disadvantaged socioeconomic backgrounds. This differential treatment is accompanied by systematically inaccurate beliefs: teachers substantially overestimate the probability that high-achieving disadvantaged students will fail in academically demanding schools. We then provide teachers with personalized feedback on their previous recommendations and objective information on the realized success of disadvantaged students. The intervention substantially reduces socioeconomic gaps in recommendations for high-achieving students. Effects are concentrated among boys assigned to teachers with the largest prior recommendation gaps and the most inaccurate beliefs. Among the high-achieving disadvantaged boys most affected by the intervention, these changes translate into higher enrollment in demanding academic tracks, without detectable adverse effects on short-run academic performance.
35701.zh_abstract: 专业人士经常为他人做出影响深远的决定，却没有系统地观察这些决定的结果。这些决定是反映了准确的预测，还是反映了系统性扭曲的信念，对机会平等具有重要意义。我们结合全国范围的行政数据、随机小插曲实验、信念诱导和实地实验，在教师对高中分流的推荐背景下研究这个问题。在控制学生的学业成绩和兴趣的情况下，当学生来自弱势的社会经济背景时，教师推荐要求严格的学术轨道的可能性显著降低。这种差异对待伴随着系统性不准确的信念：教师显著高估了高成就的弱势学生在学业要求严格的学校中失败的概率。然后，我们向教师提供关于他们先前推荐的个性化反馈，以及关于弱势学生实际成功的客观信息。该干预显著缩小了高成就学生推荐中的社会经济差距。这些效应集中在那些先前推荐差距最大且信念最不准确的教师所分配的男生中。在受干预影响最大的高成就弱势男生中，这些变化转化为更高比例的严格学术轨道入学率，而对短期学业成绩没有可检测的不利影响。

35700.title: Cross-Section Estimation of Long-Run Relations Using Time-Compressed Data
35700.zh_title: 使用时间压缩数据的长期关系横截面估计
35700.zh_abstract_excerpt: 许多关于长期关系的实证研究基于平均化或长期差分数据的横截面回归，这些数据实际上将T × N面板的时间维度压缩了。我们分析了一类时间压缩的I(1)数据，并表明它们具有放大的变异性，这源于非平稳面板的横截面方差随时间“扇形展开”。在时间压缩数据中进行横截面回归，无论回归元是平稳的、非平稳的还是高度持久的，都可能产生超一致且渐近正态的估计。最快的收敛速度√NT需要一种压缩方案，该方案不仅放大非平稳信号，还要稀释回归噪声。
35700.abstract: Many empirical investigations of long-run relations are based on cross-section regressions in averaged or long differenced data that effectively have the time dimension of a T × N panel compressed. We analyze a class of time-compressed I(1) data and show that they have magnified variability stemming from the fact that the cross-section variance of a non-stationary panel ‘fans out’ with time. Cross-section regressions in time compressed data can potentially yield estimates that are super-consistent and asymptotically normal, whether the regressors are stationary, non-stationary, or highly persistent. The fastest convergence rate of √NT requires a compression scheme that not only magnifies the non-stationary signal, but also dilutes the regression noise. Omitted fixed effects preclude noise dilution but the estimates remain superconsistent. However, the fanning out effect can be weakened when the data have a strong force for mean-reversion or convergence, a problem that seems relevant for temperature data. We consider three applications and find that the long-run relation between consumption and income, and between growth/inflation and demographic variables are reasonably well determined, but the estimated relation between growth and warming temperature is fragile.

35757.title: Buying a Station or Relaxing a Constraint? Spectrum Repacking and Dirac's Conjecture
35757.zh_title: 购买电视台还是放松约束？频谱重打包与狄拉克猜想
35757.zh_abstract_excerpt: 频谱重打包拍卖可以通过两条边际恢复可行性：通过买断让电视台退役，或放松成对的工程限制。我将电视台表示为网络中的顶点，将干扰限制表示为它们之间的边，因此电视台买断删除顶点，工程豁免放松边。本文表明，买断任何一个电视台都可以减少所需频道数量，尽管放松任何单一干扰限制不能。最小可行频道数为 $k$。对于每个 $k\geq4$，我表明存在一个网络，其中移除任何电视台都能节省一个频道，而放松任何单一成对限制则不能。
35757.abstract: Spectrum repacking auctions can restore feasibility along two margins: retiring a station via buyout or relaxing a pairwise engineering restriction. I represent stations as vertices in a network and interference restrictions as edges between them, and so station buyouts delete vertices and engineering waivers relax edges. This paper shows that buying out any one station can reduce the number of channels needed, even though relaxing any single interference restriction cannot. The smallest feasible number of channels is $k$ . For every $k\geq4$, I show that there is a network in which removing any station saves one channel, while relaxing any single pairwise restriction does not. This main result follows directly from Dirac’s half-century-old conjecture on vertex-critical graphs, whose chromatic number falls after any vertex is removed. By constructing the missing counterexample at $k=4$ and combining it with earlier results for $k\geq5$, I show that at every $k\geq4$, some $k$-vertex-critical graph has no critical edge, resolving Dirac's conjecture. Market designers auditing feasibility link-by-link systematically can mistake combinatorial complementarity for remedy failure, overlooking station buyouts that unlock the clearing target.

35756.title: Do Social Norms Substitute for Enforcement? Evidence from Public Officials’ Home Purchases in Singapore
35756.zh_title: 社会规范能替代执法吗？来自新加坡公职人员购房的证据
35756.authors: Tomasz Piskorski, Amit Seru, Jian Zhang, Chun Zhao
35756.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究廉洁社会规范能否替代正式执法以威慑公职人员的不当行为。新加坡被广泛认为是世界上最不腐败的国家之一，为检验数十年成功的反腐败执法能否产生自我维持的规范提供了一个鲜明的环境。利用全量住房交易数据，我们识别了公务员在 Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) 系统扩建前后的知情购房行为。相对于匹配的不知情对照组，公务员不成比例地购买靠近已规划但尚未公开宣布站点的房屋，效应集中在公开宣布前一到两年。
35756.abstract: We study whether pro-integrity social norms can substitute for formal enforcement in deterring misconduct by public officials. Singapore, widely regarded as one of the world’s least corrupt countries, provides a sharp setting to examine whether decades of successful anti-corruption enforcement can produce self-sustaining norms. Using universe-level housing transactions, we identify informed home purchases by civil servants around expansions of the Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) system. Relative to a matched uninformed control, civil servants disproportionately purchase homes near planned—but not yet publicly announced—stations, with the effect concentrated one to two years before public announcements. The behavior is concentrated among mid-level officials and agencies connected to rail planning, generates meaningful private gains, and also appears among relatives, consistent with information leakage. Stronger formal enforcement substantially reduces both direct and indirect misconduct. We combine the transaction evidence with independent survey measures of perceived corruption, public trust, and pro-integrity norms and develop a dynamic model in which norms are persistent but fragile, enforcement both directly deters misconduct and indirectly sustains norms, and policymakers learn about the persistence of norms from noisy integrity signals. Observed pre-tightening misconduct, deterioration in survey-based integrity measures, and the subsequent decline in misconduct following stronger enforcement are more consistent with policymakers learning that norms have limited persistence than with a response to transitory noise. The findings suggest that even in high-integrity societies, social norms may not be sufficiently self-sustaining to maintain a low-corruption equilibrium without continued formal enforcement.

35755.title: The Macroeconomic Returns to School Finance Reforms: Micro-Calibrated Predictions Meet Causal Evidence
35755.zh_title: 学校财政改革的宏观经济回报：微观校准预测与因果证据的相遇
35755.zh_abstract_excerpt: 大量文献认为人力资本在决定宏观经济产出中发挥核心作用，而另一类文献记录了教育投资的可观私人回报。然而，私人收益是否能转化为总体收益仍不确定，因为信号、挤出或一般均衡调整可能在私人回报和总体回报之间造成楔子。本文通过州级学校财政改革 (SFRs) 增加宏观经济产出的因果证据来连接这些文献。首先，我将基于设计的 SFR 对私人收入影响的微观估计与队列替换框架相结合，模拟州级人均工人收入。
35755.abstract: A large literature posits a central role for human capital in determining macroeconomic output, while another documents substantial private returns to educational investment. However, whether private gains translate into aggregate gains remains uncertain, as signaling, displacement, or general-equilibrium adjustment may drive a wedge between private and aggregate returns. This paper bridges these literatures with causal evidence that state-level school finance reforms (SFRs) increase macroeconomic output. First, I combine design-based micro estimates of SFR effects on private earnings with a cohort replacement framework to simulate state-level earnings per worker. The simulation predicts little change for 10 to 15 years, then gradual gains as treated cohorts enter the labor force, reaching 7.8 percent after 60 years. Next, I test this prediction using the staggered implementation of SFRs across U.S. states. In an event-study framework, state-level earnings per worker track the predicted path, remaining flat through about 15 years before rising roughly 4.7 percent above counterfactual levels after 30 years — consistent with private earnings gains aggregating to the broader economy. Finally, I show that these effects extend to broader economic output, with GDP per capita declining modestly initially before rising to more than 5 percent above its counterfactual path after 30 years.

35754.title: Asset Privatization as Intergenerational Redistribution
35754.zh_title: 资产私有化作为代际再分配
35754.authors: Kaiji Chen, Hanming Fang, Yang Tang
35754.zh_abstract_excerpt: 快速经济增长造成了各代人终身收入的巨大差异。本文考察快速增长经济体中，通过补贴性获得增值公共资产所产生的代际再分配。我们表明，在未来增长完全资本化到市场价值之前，向当代人提供对这些资产的补贴性获得机会，使他们提前获得对随后经济增长的索取权，从而将资源从未来世代再分配给当代世代。在住房私有化的背景下，私有化住房随后的资本利得使房主能够换购升级，进一步放大住房需求、房价和代际再分配。
35754.abstract: Rapid economic growth creates large differences in lifetime incomes across generations. This paper examines the intergenerational redistribution generated by subsidized access to appreciating public assets in rapidly growing economies. We show that providing incumbent generations with subsidized access to these assets before future growth is fully capitalized into market values gives them an early claim on subsequent economic growth, thereby redistributing resources from future to incumbent generations. In the context of housing privatization, subsequent capital gains on privatized housing enable homeowners to trade up, further amplifying housing demand, house prices, and intergenerational redistribution. We evaluate the early ownership and capital gains channels of asset-based redistribution in a quantitative equilibrium model calibrated to China's housing privatization. Relative to more standard pension-based redistribution, we show that asset-based redistribution delivers higher welfare for future cohorts while substantially reducing long-run fiscal burdens once economic growth unexpectedly slows.

35753.title: Correlation Neglect in Asset Prices
35753.zh_title: 资产价格中的相关性忽视
35753.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们记录了股票市场收益之间强烈的负序列相关：i) 一个季度的第二个月与 ii) 随后一个季度的第一个月。这种模式的出现是因为投资者未能充分认识到一个季度第二个月较晚发布的盈利公告所传达的可预测重复性总体盈利“新闻”。被忽视的相关性导致过度反应，而当新一季度的盈利公布时，这种过度反应又被纠正。与这一假说一致，一个季度第二个月的收益与前一个月的收益正相关，并且当这两个月公布的盈利更相似时，收益模式会放大。
35753.abstract: We document a strong negative serial correlation between stock market returns in i) the second month of a quarter and ii) the first month of the subsequent quarter. This pattern arises as investors fail to fully recognize the predictably repetitive aggregate earnings “news” conveyed by the late earnings announcements in the second month of a quarter. The neglected correlation leads to overreaction, which is in turn corrected when earnings of a new quarter are announced. Consistent with this hypothesis, returns in the second month of a quarter positively correlate with those of the preceding month, and the return pattern amplifies when earnings announced in these two months are more similar. Survey data and industry-level returns lend further support to this mechanism. These results provide evidence of correlation neglect even among sophisticated, financially incentivized decision-makers, underscoring its importance as a behavioral phenomenon.

35752.title: Did COVID Change the Black Neighborhood Startup Deficit? Evidence from the Startup Cartography Project
35752.zh_title: COVID 是否改变了黑人社区初创企业赤字？来自 Startup Cartography Project 的证据
35752.authors: Catherine E. Fazio, Jorge Guzman, Scott Stern, Yan Xu
35752.zh_abstract_excerpt: 受 William Julius Wilson 对集中劣势的论述启发，我们考察对黑人社区低创业率的本地贫困陷阱解释。使用来自 38 个州的注册数据，我们记录了长期存在的黑人社区初创企业赤字。在提高了经济活跃度预期的冲击中，该赤字在 2020 年急剧逆转，尤其是在既有赤字更大的地方。虽然总体盈余逐渐减弱，但在高赤字黑人社区中，相对创业率仍然较高，并且面向社区的创业率也一直较高，直到 2024 年。

Amid shocks that raised expectations of greater economic activity, the deficit reverses sharply in 2020, particularly where pre-existing deficits were larger. While the overall surplus attenuates, relative entrepreneurship remains elevated in high-deficit Black neighborhoods, and neighborhood-oriented entrepreneurship also remains elevated through 2024. Together, these patterns are consistent with a partially sustained shift toward a higher-activity equilibrium.

35751.title: Did the Affordable Care Act Save Lives?
35751.zh_title: 《平价医疗法案》是否拯救了生命？
35751.authors: Anuj Gangopadhyaya, Cuiping Schiman, Robert Kaestner
35751.zh_abstract_excerpt: 尽管近期研究已提供证据表明《平价医疗法案》（ACA）的医疗补助扩展降低了死亡率，但尚无证据表明ACA在医疗补助扩展之外的净效应对死亡率的影响。这是一个重要的知识空白，因为ACA显著提高了未扩展州的医疗保险覆盖率。在本文中，我们利用ACA带来的医疗保险覆盖率的大幅增加，考察ACA和医疗补助扩展对死亡率的影响。
35751.abstract: While recent research has provided evidence that the Medicaid expansions of the Affordable Care Act (ACA) reduced mortality, there is no evidence on the effect of the Affordable Care Act (ACA) net of the Medicaid expansions on mortality. This is an important gap in knowledge because the ACA significantly increased health insurance coverage in non-expansion states. In this article, we exploit the large increase in health insurance coverage brought forth by the ACA to examine the effect of the ACA and Medicaid expansions on mortality. Unlike prior studies that relied solely on geographic variation in Medicaid expansions to estimate the net effect of the expansion, we use a novel empirical approach that allows us to investigate the effect of the ACA net of Medicaid expansion on mortality, the incremental effect of the Medicaid expansion, and the overall effect of the ACA including Medicaid expansion. We use longitudinal data from the NHIS Linked Mortality Files (LMF) and a nationally representative sample of 40 to 58-year-olds combined with a difference-in-differences and a difference-in-differences-in-differences research design to obtain estimates of the effect of the ACA on mortality. We find no evidence that the Medicaid expansions had a beneficial effect on mortality but do find that the ACA net of Medicaid expansion reduced mortality.

35750.title: Informed Choices: Gender Gaps in Career Advice
35750.zh_title: 知情选择：职业建议中的性别差距
35750.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本文提供了首个因果证据，表明性别影响个人所获得的职业信息。我们进行了一项大规模实地实验，真实大学生向10,000名在职专业人士寻求职业信息。我们随机化专业人士收到的是来自男学生还是女学生的信息。当学生广泛询问职业信息时，女学生收到的关于工作与生活平衡的信息显著多于男学生。当学生专门询问工作与生活平衡时，这种性别差异依然存在。一项针对专业人士的调查表明，与女性讨论工作与生活平衡存在非利他动机。
35750.abstract: This paper provides the first causal evidence that gender affects the information an individual receives about careers. We conduct a large-scale field experiment in which real college students seek career information from 10,000 working professionals. We randomize whether a professional receives a message from a male or a female student. When students ask broadly for information about a career, female students receive substantially more information on work/life balance than male students. This gender difference persists when students specifically ask about work/life balance. A survey of professionals suggests non-altruistic motives for discussing work/life balance with women. Combining findings from the field experiment and results from an information intervention, we conclude that gender gaps in information received about work/life balance are consequential for gender gaps in career intentions.

35749.title: We've Got You Covered: Establishment-Level Evidence on California's Fast-Food Minimum Wage
35749.zh_title: 我们为你提供保障：加州快餐最低工资的机构层面证据
35749.authors: Vitor C. Melo, David Neumark, Liam Sigaud, Gary A. Wagner
35749.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究加州20美元快餐最低工资的就业效应。评估这一政策在常用总体数据集中面临两个挑战：覆盖范围基于60家机构连锁规模阈值，而该阈值无法识别；用于识别快餐店的行业代码存在测量误差。我们使用机构层面数据来应对这些挑战。我们发现负面就业效应的证据，但这些效应集中在小连锁店中，政策还减缓了小连锁店的进入并增加了退出。因此，快餐最低工资的主要效应是使小连锁店处于不利地位，尽管迄今为止总体就业效应较为温和。
35749.abstract: We study the employment effects of California’s $20 fast-food minimum wage. Evaluating this policy poses two challenges in commonly used aggregate datasets: coverage is based on 60-establishment chain-size threshold that cannot be identified; and there is measurement error in the industry codes used to identify fast-food restaurants. We address these challenges using establishment-level data. We find evidence of negative employment effects, but they are concentrated among small chains, among which the policy also slowed entry and increased exit. Thus, the primary effect of the fast-food minimum wage was to disadvantage small chains, albeit with modest overall employment effects thus far.

35748.title: Does Information Influence the Choice between Social Security Disability and Early Retirement Benefits?
35748.zh_title: 信息是否影响社会保障残疾福利与提前退休福利之间的选择？
35748.authors: Priyanka Anand, Tran Thi Phu-Duyen, Sita Slavov
35748.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们考察信息如何影响62岁至完全退休年龄之间人群在社会保障残疾保险（DI）和老年保险（OAI）福利之间的选择。我们发现，收到初始社会保障声明——该声明向接收者提供DI和OAI可获得的个性化估计福利金额——会增加那些有工作限制健康状况或低工作能力指数的人申请这两个项目的概率，且这种反应集中在距离完全退休年龄较远的人群中。DI申请的增加在仅申请DI和同时申请两个项目之间平分。
35748.abstract: We examine how information affects the choice between Social Security Disability Insurance (DI) and Old-Age Insurance (OAI) benefits for people between 62 and full retirement age. We find that receiving an initial Social Security statement, which provides recipients with personalized estimated benefit amounts available from DI and OAI, increases the probability of applying for both programs among those with a work-limiting health condition or a low work ability index, and this response is concentrated among people who are further from full retirement age. The increase in DI applications is split between applications for DI only and applications for both programs.

35747.title: Automation and Optimal Taxation: A Task-Based Theory
35747.zh_title: 自动化与最优税收：基于任务的理论
35747.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们在基于任务的自动化模型中刻画最优劳动和资本所得税。工人和机器在可自动化任务中是完美替代品，这些任务从技能分布的底部延伸到某一阈值。工人在广延边际上供给劳动。资本家以有限弹性供给机器。在这个一般均衡自动化经济中，最优税收公式采取经典的部分均衡形式。然而，自动化大幅改变最优税率，因为工资和资本回报是内生的。我们将模型校准至美国工资分布和自动化暴露。在均衡中，中产阶级被自动化程度最高，机器强度在第40个工资百分位附近达到峰值。
35747.abstract: We characterize optimal labor and capital income taxation in a task-based model of automation. Workers and machines are perfect substitutes in automatable tasks, which run from the bottom of the skill distribution up to a threshold. Workers supply labor on the extensive margin. Capitalists supply machines at a finite elasticity. In this general-equilibrium automation economy, optimal tax formulas take canonical partial-equilibrium forms. Yet automation substantially changes optimal tax rates because wages and capital returns are endogenous. We calibrate the model to the US wage distribution and automation exposure. In equilibrium, the middle class is the most automated, with machine intensity peaking around the 40th wage percentile. Relative to a no-automation benchmark, the optimal labor tax schedule is more progressive: a larger EITC subsidy at the bottom, lower taxes in the middle, and higher taxes at the top. The optimal capital tax is sizable but unaffected by automation.

35746.title: Heritability and Social Interaction in Labor Market Outcomes: Evidence from the Population of Twins in the United States
35746.zh_title: 劳动力市场结果中的遗传率与社会互动：来自美国双胞胎总体的证据
35746.authors: David Card, Jesse Rothstein, Moises Yi
35746.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们使用2000年人口普查中作为青少年观测到的44,000对双胞胎的数据，并将其与20年后的收入相关联，以研究劳动力市场结果的遗传率。我们扩展了经典双胞胎设计（CTD），该设计从同卵和异卵双胞胎之间的对比中识别遗传率，扩展到分析者无法观测卵性但可以测量同性双胞胎和异性双胞胎结果的情形。我们还允许存在一个家庭和性别特定成分，该成分影响同性兄弟姐妹，但仅被异性兄弟姐妹部分共享。
35746.abstract: We use data on 44,000 twin pairs observed as adolescents in the 2000 Census, linked to their earnings 20 years later, to study the heritability of labor market outcomes. We extend the Classical Twins Design (CTD), which identifies heritability from contrasts between monozygotic and dizygotic twins, to settings where an analyst does not observe zygosity but can measure outcomes for same-sex and opposite-sex twins. We also allow for the presence of a family- and sex-specific component affecting same-sex siblings but only partly shared by opposite-sex siblings. Our extended model identifies heritability from the difference-in-differences of same-sex vs. opposite-sex twins vs. siblings. The estimates indicate strong heritability (h² approximately 0.36) of log earnings. Using an AKM (Abowd et al., 1999) decomposition that separates the person-specific component of earnings from employer-specific pay premiums, we find that both components are heritable. The heritability of employer pay premiums, however, is mainly driven by same-sex twins who work at the same firm, suggesting that social interactions may lead to an over-estimate of the genetic component in earnings. Excluding siblings who work together leads to estimates of the heritability of log earnings that are 15% lower. Similar biases may be present in CTD-based estimates of heritability for other social outcomes like education.

35745.title: The Federal Lands: An Economic Property Rights Perspective
35745.zh_title: 联邦土地：一个经济产权视角
35745.zh_abstract_excerpt: 美国联邦政府拥有并管理着472,892,659英亩土地，占下48州陆地面积的21%，是美国最大的土地所有者。该资源作为集体资源——联邦土地——通过政治和官僚对多用途原则的解释以及通常的最大持续产量生物目标来持有和管理。相比之下，美国大多数其他自然资源的获取、交换和投资是通过私有产权和市场进行的。尽管资源规模巨大，经济学家对其经济和福利影响的关注相对有限。本文旨在提出经济含义并鼓励更多的经济分析。
35745.abstract: The US federal government owns and administers 472,892,659 acres or 21% of the land area of the lower 48 states, the country’s largest landowner. The resource is held and managed as a collective resource, the Federal Lands, through political and bureaucratic interpretation of the Multiple Use principle and generally, the biological aim of maximum sustained-yield. By contrast, access, exchange, and investment for most other US natural resources are through private property rights and markets. Despite the magnitude of the resource, economists have devoted relatively limited attention to the economic and welfare impact. The objective is to suggest economic implications and to encourage additional economic analyses. The discussion summarizes federal lands privatization through 1891, when withholding of federal lands began. The literature reveals no demonstratable market failure or increased resource scarcity from private exploitation between 1870 and 1957 when most lands were withheld. Because land was nonmobile and observable private property rights could have been assigned and any externalities addressed via Pigouvian restrictions or Coasean exchange. Federal ownership was not obviously required. Progressive Era reformers, driven by concerns of impending resource depletion, called for scientific, sustained-yield management by government officials. The institutional change is economically important. As outlined by Dixit and others, private rights holders have high powered incentives for efficient resource use that are lacking in decision making by agency officials who do not hold exchangeable property rights and do not directly bear the economic costs and benefits of their actions. Consequential public goods delivery could be an offset, but these are not measured for tradeoff calculations. Following Krueger, a rent-seeking framework is presented for comparing outcomes with economic property rights and political management. The analysis suggests that a.) federal lands will have lower production value than comparable private, all else equal; (b). federal lands management will be less responsive to shifts in economic costs and benefits. Public goods may be provided for high amenity, recreation, and ecological areas, but the dominant Multiple Use management principle provides no objective criteria for allocation or for periodic outcome assessment and adjustment. A literature review and data for contemporary federal forests, range, and oil and gas lands are provided.

35744.title: The Measurement Revolution? Credible Measurement and Inference in the Age of AI
35744.zh_title: 测量革命？人工智能时代的可信测量与推断
35744.zh_abstract_excerpt: 人工智能（AI）正在改变经济学中的测量。AI模型以低成本将非结构化数据（如文本和图像）转换为结构化变量，使以前不可行的测量能够大规模实现。这将瓶颈从寻找任何可扩展的现象测量转向在许多看似合理的测量中进行选择，而这些测量可能支持不同的实证结论。本综述为应对这一转变提供了指导。我们描述了AI进入测量管道的三个阶段——发现、构念定义和观察——以及每个阶段对研究者的要求。
35744.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming measurement in economics. AI models convert unstructured data, such as text and images, into structured variables at low cost, making previously prohibitive measurement feasible at scale. This shifts the bottleneck from finding any scalable measure of a phenomenon to choosing among many plausible ones, which may support different empirical conclusions. This review provides guidance for navigating that shift. We describe three stages at which AI enters the measurement pipeline—discovery, construct definition, and observation—and what each demands of researchers. We argue that credible inference with AI-generated variables requires appropriately designed validation: anchoring measurement to explicit criteria, rather than informal claims that a proxy is reasonable. We then examine how validation samples support valid inference even when AI predictions are arbitrarily biased, and what can be done when a random validation sample is unavailable.

35743.title: Immigration and Child Mortality during the Age of Mass Migration

35743.authors: Katherine Eriksson, Peter Zhixian Lin, Gregory Niemesh
35743.zh_abstract_excerpt: 在19世纪末，美国人担心拥挤的移民社区正在通过工业城市传播疾病。我们使用新构建的马萨诸塞州1860年至1915年城镇层面面板数据来研究这一说法，这一背景特别适合此项研究，因为其早期生命登记系统允许在全国登记普及之前一致地测量死亡率。使用基于历史定居模式的移动份额工具变量策略，我们估计了当地移民暴露对死亡率的影响。相关问题不是移民家庭本身是否经历了更高的死亡率，而是移民是否更广泛地改变了当地的疾病环境。
35743.abstract: In the late nineteenth century, Americans feared that crowded immigrant neighborhoods were spreading disease through industrial cities. Mechanical changes in the composition of births by parent nativity account for only a portion of the estimated effect, implying that the results are not driven primarily by higher mortality among immigrant births. Instead, the evidence is consistent with increased exposure to immigrants, communicable disease, and spillovers to children of native-born parents. These findings highlight immigration as one factor shaping the mortality transition in crowded high-mortality environments.

35742.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们测量了过去5年美元安全资产的便利收益率来回答这个问题。我们发现，在美元资产集合内，2025年的安全资产便利收益率与2019年大致相同，并且这些水平预计将在未来十年持续。在全球范围内，美元安全资产（尤其是美国国债）相对于其他货币安全资产的溢价已大幅下降。还有证据表明，美元回购目前是便利性最高的美元安全资产。简而言之，我们的答案是：就国内流动性目的而言，没有；就全球流动性目的而言，有。

35741.title: Diamond-Mirrlees meets Sims: Optimal Taxation with Rational Inattention

35741.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究当消费者具有理性疏忽且规划者将消费者的注意力成本内部化时的最优商品税。在我们的设定中，消费者可能对税收反应不足，可能在不同商品之间不均匀地分配注意力，并可能表现出稀疏行为或心理账户。我们的主要结果是，这不一定改变税收设计：在一个基准情形中，无论疏忽的程度和内生性如何，最优税收满足与经典公共财政相同的充分统计量公式。偏离这一基准时，我们为状态依赖税收提供了双重理由，并为税收显著性提供了新视角；

35740.title: When Resources Meet Relationships: The Returns to Personalized Supports for Low-Income Students

35740.authors: Benjamin Goldman, Jamie Gracie, Sonya Porter
35740.zh_abstract_excerpt: 来自低收入家庭的儿童面临课堂之外的障碍，这些障碍阻碍学习并限制经济流动性的机会。我们研究Communities In Schools（CIS），这是一个在高贫困学校安置协调员以将困难学生与个性化支持联系起来的项目。协调员将学生与解决学业、行为和基本需求的资源相匹配——如辅导、心理健康咨询和住房稳定。CIS是美国同类项目中最大的，每年覆盖200万学生。利用CIS的分阶段推广，我们发现该项目提高了困难学生的考试成绩。
35740.abstract: Children from low-income families face barriers outside the classroom that impede learning and limit opportunities for economic mobility. We study Communities In Schools (CIS), a program that places coordinators in high-poverty schools to connect struggling students with personalized support. Coordinators match students to resources that address academic, behavioral, and basic needs—such as tutoring, mental health counseling, and housing stabilization. CIS is the largest program of its kind in the U.S., reaching 2 million students annually. Using the staggered rollout of CIS, we find that the program boosts test scores for struggling students. These gains persist, raising high school completion and adult earnings. Improvements in test scores explain only about half of CIS's impact on high school graduation; the remainder reflects progress on non-cognitive outcomes such as attendance and behavior. Consistent with CIS's emphasis on personalization, coordinators tailor services to distinct student needs, yet students with different needs experience comparable long-run gains. Placing a trusted adult in schools, backed by a network of programs and services, may offer a scalable way to improve economic mobility.

35739.authors: Crossan Cooper, Katja Seim, Jintaek Song
35739.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究了首个在全州范围内对含糖饮料和糖果实施的SNAP限制。受限支出下降11%；热量和糖分下降5–8%。替代效应是不对称的：符合条件的果汁饮料部分抵消了汽水消费的下降，而糖果限制则减少了符合条件零食的购买。零售商几乎不改变货架价格。失去SNAP的销售税豁免仅使含税价格上升1.9%。在SNAP使用率更高的零售商处，支出下降幅度更大，并且在结账污名较不显著的线上渠道仍然很大。

35738.authors: Lori A. Beaman, Seema Jayachandran, Anisha Sharma
35738.zh_abstract_excerpt: 公共空间中的性别骚扰通过受害经历直接作用于女性，也通过恐惧间接作用于女性。我们在印度城市中衡量这两种效应；在印度城市，骚扰被普遍认为十分猖獗。通过对在新德里和班加罗尔公共空间招募的4000多名女性进行调查，我们记录到：新德里65%的女性、班加罗尔29%的女性在过去一年中曾在公共空间遭遇骚扰。过去一年中，猥亵、跟踪或性侵的发生率在新德里为41%，在班加罗尔为14%。

We measure these dual effects in urban India, where harassment is widely regarded as pervasive. Surveying over 4,000 women recruited in public spaces in New Delhi and Bengaluru, we document that 65% of women in New Delhi and 29% in Bengaluru experienced harassment in public spaces in the past year. Past-year prevalence of groping, stalking, or sexual assault is 41% in New Delhi and 14% in Bengaluru. Both frequent, less severe forms of harassment and rarer, more severe forms generate anxiety among women; for example, 46% of women in New Delhi and 25% in Bengaluru report feeling extremely anxious about sexual assault when in public spaces. Not all of the indirect effects track the across-city variation in experienced harassment: in both cities, roughly 70\% of women report that fear of harassment affects whether they work. Finally, on measurement, we show that measured prevalence is more sensitive to questionnaire design where harassment is less common and victims have fewer and less recent incidents to recall.

35737.authors: Nano Barahona, Cristóbal Otero, Sebastián Otero, Joshua J. Kim
35737.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究了智利实施的一项包装正面标签政策的总体效应和异质性效应。我们发现，消费者分别将糖摄入量和热量摄入量减少了9%和6%。在需求侧，标签促使消费者在类别内部进行替代，而不是在类别之间切换。当标签提供新信息时，类别内反应更为明显。在供给侧，我们观察到在监管阈值处出现堆积，并且不同类别之间存在显著异质性，这与产品配方调整成本不同相一致。我们得出结论：考虑政策反应异质性对于有效的政策设计至关重要。

35736.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本文研究了美国最大的空间再开发行动之一：HOPE VI公共住房拆除项目。我们以芝加哥为研究对象，估计了一个邻里选择模型，该模型结合了追踪被搬迁公共住房居民的行政记录，以及捕捉全市分选和价格的美国人口普查局数据。拆除项目产生了巨大的福利损失，其驱动因素是搬迁成本，而住房券部分抵消了这些损失。拆除项目还提高了住房价格并重塑了邻里构成，其收益集中在收入较高的房主群体。

35735.title: Flowers of Invention: The Economic Impacts of Patent Rights
35735.zh_title: 发明之花：专利权的经济影响
35735.zh_abstract_excerpt: 专利权如何影响创新和下游生产？美国于1985年将专利保护引入植物生物技术，并且由于作物的繁殖结构不同，其对作物的影响也存在差异。利用植物花结构这一独特特征以及一个新的作物特定技术开发数据集，我发现专利权的引入增加了新型植物品种的开发。技术开发是由私营部门研究投资的快速增长推动的，并伴随着对某些非生物农业技术创新的正向溢出效应，还带来了作物产量的提高。然而，专利权可能给技术消费者带来潜在的重大成本，并对下游生产造成扭曲。
35735.abstract: How do patent rights affect innovation and downstream production? Patent protection was introduced for plant biotechnology in the United States in 1985, and it affected crops differentially depending on their reproductive structures. Exploiting this unique feature of plant flower structure and a new dataset of crop-specific technology development, I find that the introduction of patent rights increased the development of novel plant varieties. Technology development was driven by a rapid increase in private sector research investment, was accompanied by positive spillover effects on innovation in certain non-biological agricultural technologies, and led to an increase in crop yields. Patent rights, however, may come with potentially significant costs to the consumers of technology and distortions to downstream production. Nevertheless, despite higher spending on seeds, US counties that were more exposed to the change in patent law because of their crop composition experienced an increase in agricultural land values and profits. Taken together, the results suggest that the prospect of patent protection spurred innovation and increased downstream productivity and profits.

35734.title: Strategic Sovereignty: U.S.–Israeli Strikes and the Reversal of Anti-Regime Protest in Iran
35734.zh_title: 战略主权：美以打击与伊朗反政权抗议的逆转
35734.authors: Sultan Mehmood, Yaroslav Prokhorskoy, Leonard Wantchekon
35734.zh_abstract_excerpt: 外国干预能否将国内动员重新导向其试图削弱的那一政权？我们研究了2026年美国和以色列对伊朗的打击，该打击发生在全国性反政府起义期间。结合高频地理编码的抗议数据与地理编码的美以打击记录，我们记录了政治动员的急剧逆转。打击前，反政府抗议广泛存在，并在2月期间因国内镇压和不断强化的“外国代理人”叙事而大幅消退。打击之后，亲政府集会以及反对美国和以色列的抗议在全国蔓延。
35734.abstract: Can foreign intervention redirect domestic mobilization toward the regime it seeks to weaken? We study the 2026 U.S.–Israeli strikes on Iran, which occurred amid a nationwide anti-government uprising. Combining high-frequency geocoded data on protests with geocoded records of U.S.–Israeli strikes, we document a sharp reversal in political mobilization. Anti-government protest was widespread before the strikes and receded sharply through February amid domestic repression and an intensifying “foreign-agent” narrative. Following the strikes, pro-government rallies and protests against the United States and Israel spread across the country. Exploiting the precise location and staggered timing of counties’ first exposure to a U.S.–Israeli strike, we find little change in total protest activity but a sharp shift from anti-government to pro-government protest. Public statements by U.S. and Israeli leaders increasingly aligned themselves with the protest movement, while Iranian officials portrayed the unrest as foreign-backed. These patterns are consistent with strategic sovereignty: overt foreign intervention can make domestic opposition easier to portray as aligned with an external adversary, weakening its legitimacy and redirecting collective action toward defense of the state.

35733.title: (Mis)measuring Uncertainty: Bunching in Probabilistic Expectations
35733.zh_title: （错误）测量不确定性：概率预期中的堆积
35733.authors: Carola Binder, Laura Crespo, Carlos Gento, Luis M. Guirola, Ernesto Villanueva
35733.zh_abstract_excerpt: 概率预期问题常被用来测量主观不确定性，但受访者经常将所有概率赋予某一结果。我们表明，这种堆积在一定程度上是调查假象，而非真正确定。在（在线）欧洲央行消费者预期调查和（面对面）西班牙家庭金融调查中，堆积在金融素养较低的受访者中更高，并随面板参与时间增加而上升。两项调查设计变更提供了更强证据：执行中立的访员协议使堆积减少约15个百分点，随后的一次问卷重新设计又使其减少18个百分点。访员层面的差异在标准化后也有所下降。
35733.abstract: Probabilistic expectation questions are often used to measure subjective uncertainty, but respondents frequently assign all probability to one outcome. We show that this bunching is partly a survey artifact rather than genuine certainty. In the (online) ECB Consumer Expectations Survey and the (in person) Spanish Survey of Household Finances, bunching is higher among less financially literate respondents and increases with panel tenure. Two survey-design changes provide stronger evidence: enforcing neutral interviewer protocols reduces bunching by about 15 percentage points, and a later questionnaire redesign reduces it by a further 18 percentage points. Interviewer-level variation also falls after standardization. These findings imply that degenerate responses in probabilistic expectations can reflect task burden and survey administration, causing standard measures to overstate certainty and understate uncertainty.

35732.title: Social Capital and Innovation: Evidence from Facebook Friendship Networks
35732.zh_title: 社会资本与创新：来自Facebook友谊网络的证据
35732.authors: Brad Cannon, David Hirshleifer, Joshua Thornton
35732.zh_abstract_excerpt: 利用Facebook友谊数据，我们研究社会资本的三个方面如何塑造创新活动。我们发现，在解释创新方面最重要的社会资本方面是经济连通性（EC）——高收入友谊所占比例。EC每高出1个标准差，在拥有专利的ZIP Code中与人均专利数多97%相关，在拥有突破性专利的ZIP Code中与人均突破性专利数多45%相关。反向因果检验、发明人内部迁移设计，以及利用水力压裂驱动的经济冲击对非本地朋友影响的准实验，支持因果解释。
35732.abstract: Using Facebook friendship data, we study how three aspects of social capital shape innovative activity. We find that the most important aspect of social capital in explaining innovation is Economic Connectedness (EC)--the share of high-income friendships. One standard deviation greater EC is associated with 97% more patents per capita among patenting ZIP Codes and 45% more breakthrough patents per capita among ZIP Codes with breakthrough patents. Reverse-causality tests, a within-inventor relocation design, and a quasi-experiment using fracking-driven economic shocks to non-local friends support a causal interpretation. Mechanism tests provide evidence consistent with a financing channel.

35731.title: Housing Wealth Accumulation and Electoral Representation
35731.zh_title: 住房财富积累与选举代表
35731.authors: Carlos Fernando Avenancio-León, Yutao He, Michael Reher
35731.zh_abstract_excerpt: 政治代表与个体行为中具有经济后果的差异系统性一致：最深地融入选举制度的房主，在积累住房财富方面系统性地更有效。利用全国选民—房产数据集，我们发现，实现的住房增值随选举参与度单调上升，并且在控制地理、党派、人口特征、财富代理变量和收入后仍然稳健。政治上积极参与的房主通过购买被低估的房产、增加改善投资以及以溢价出售，主动创造价值，这表明存在个体层面差异，而非被动市场暴露。
35731.abstract: Political representation is systematically aligned with economically consequential differences in individual behavior: homeowners who are most deeply incorporated into electoral institutions are systematically more effective at accumulating housing wealth. Using a nationwide voter-property dataset, we find that realized housing appreciation increases monotonically with electoral participation, robust to controls for geography, partisanship, demographics, wealth proxies, and income. Politically engaged homeowners actively generate value by purchasing undervalued properties, investing more in improvements, and selling at a premium, indicating individual-level differences rather than passive market exposure. An original survey shows that these homeowners also systematically differ in personality traits, pointing to deeper individual differences associated with both political engagement and housing-market performance.
35731.zh_abstract: 政治代表与个体行为中具有经济后果的差异系统性一致：最深地融入选举制度的房主，在积累住房财富方面系统性地更有效。利用全国选民—房产数据集，我们发现，实现的住房增值随选举参与度单调上升，并且在控制地理、党派、人口特征、财富代理变量和收入后仍然稳健。政治上积极参与的房主通过购买被低估的房产、增加改善投资以及以溢价出售，主动创造价值，这表明存在个体层面差异，而非被动市场暴露。一项原创调查显示，这些房主在人格特质上也系统性不同，指向与政治参与和住房市场表现都相关的更深层个体差异。

35730.title: Beyond the Conventional Narrative: Economic Heterogeneity and Human Capital Among American Indians
35730.zh_title: 超越传统叙事：美洲印第安人的经济异质性与人力资本
35730.zh_abstract_excerpt: 美洲印第安人在经济、教育和健康结果方面存在显著异质性，这种异质性由地理位置（城市与农村）、资源禀赋以及联邦政策的历史经历等因素塑造。尽管如此，有明确证据表明，包括强制迁移、寄宿学校和同化努力在内的历史政策，对这些人群的人力资本发展和代际流动产生了长期负面影响。近几十年来，一些领域有所改善，尤其是在部落行使更大自治权并实施创新经济发展战略的地方。本文强调，“一刀切”方法不足以分析原住民与后来移民后代在多种结果上差异的来源及潜在补救。
35730.abstract: There is substantial heterogeneity in economic, educational, and health outcomes among American Indians, shaped by factors such as geographic location (urban vs. rural), resource endowments, and historical experiences with federal policies. Nonetheless, there is clear evidence that historical policies, including forced relocation, boarding schools, and assimilation efforts, have had long-lasting negative effects on human capital development and intergenerational mobility in these populations. Recent decades have seen improvements in some areas, particularly where tribes have exercised greater self-governance and implemented innovative economic development strategies. This paper emphasizes that a “one-size-fits-all” approach is inadequate for analyzing the sources and potential remediation of disparities across various outcomes between Native populations and descendants of later arrivals. A unique challenge is that the measurement and analysis of American Indian outcomes are complicated by issues of racial and tribal identification, data limitations, and changing definitions. These challenges can obscure true trends and make it difficult to evaluate the effectiveness of policies or programs, underscoring the need for more precise and disaggregated data. This essay comments on the need for caution and clarity in the use and analysis of data for this population in both historical and contemporary settings.

35729.title: When Microenterprises Grow, Are Consumers Better Off? Evidence from Large Loans to Microenterprises in Chile
35729.zh_title: 微型企业成长时，消费者是否受益？来自智利对微型企业大额贷款的证证据
35729.authors: Dean Karlan, Natalia Rigol, Benjamin N. Roth
35729.zh_abstract_excerpt: 对微型企业信贷的评估通常只衡量对借款企业的影响。但它们的客户呢？如果微型企业销售相对无差异的商品和服务，正如常被假设的那样，信贷可能只是重新分配企业之间的销售，几乎不会创造消费者收益。在智利的一项随机对照试验中，大额贷款使受处理企业的利润每月增加292美元，增幅为13.4%。客户调查数据表明，客户获得的收益更大：消费者剩余每月增加494美元。
35729.abstract: Evaluations of microenterprise credit typically measure effects only on borrowing firms. But what about their customers? If microenterprises sell relatively undifferentiated goods and services, as is often hypothesized, credit may simply reallocate sales across firms and create little consumer benefit. In a randomized controlled trial in Chile, large loans increased treated firms’ profits by USD 292 per month, a 13.4% increase. Customer survey data indicate even larger benefits for customers: a gain of USD 494 per month in consumer surplus. Furthermore, using a sample of more than 125,000 non-treated firms operating in the same markets, we find little evidence of business stealing. The welfare gains from credit expansion thus extend well beyond the borrowers themselves.
35729.zh_abstract: 对微型企业信贷的评估通常只衡量对借款企业的影响。但它们的客户呢？如果微型企业销售相对无差异的商品和服务，正如常被假设的那样，信贷可能只是重新分配企业之间的销售，几乎不会创造消费者收益。在智利的一项随机对照试验中，大额贷款使受处理企业的利润每月增加292美元，增幅为13.4%。客户调查数据表明，客户获得的收益更大：消费者剩余每月增加494美元。此外，使用在同一市场中经营的超过125,000家未受处理企业的样本，我们几乎未发现业务被窃取的证据。因此，信贷扩张带来的福利收益远远超出借款人本身。

35728.title: Who Matters in College? Familiarity, Ability Signals, and Student Achievement
35728.zh_title: 大学中谁重要？熟悉度、能力信号与学生成绩
35728.authors: Isaac Ahimbisibwe, Scott E. Carrell, Travis Lybbert
35728.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本研究考察，当学生进入新的社会环境并接触到公开可观察的学术能力信号时，学术表现的社会影响在向大学过渡期间如何演变。利用乌干达一所大型、精英且语言和文化高度异质的公立大学的行政数据，并利用学生被随机分配到宿舍这一机制，我们考察接触同族同龄人和具有奖学金身份的同龄人如何影响学术表现。我们发现，更多接触来自相似语言和文化背景的同龄人，会改善大学早期的学业成绩，但这些效应随时间消退。
35728.abstract: This study examines how social influences on academic performance evolve during transition to university when students encounter new social environments and publicly observable signals of academic ability. Using administrative data from a large, elite, and linguistically and culturally heterogeneous public university in Uganda and exploiting random assignment of students to dormitories, we examine how exposure to coethnic peers and peers with scholarship status affects academic performance. We find that greater exposure to peers from similar linguistic and cultural backgrounds improve academic achievement early in university, but these effects fade over time. In contrast, exposure to scholarship peers generates persistent gains in academic performance that increase in magnitude over time. Our setting allows us to distinguish between peers’ underlying academic ability and publicly observable signals of ability since scholarship status is visible, while underlying academic preparation is not. We find that exposure to scholarship peers improves academic performance regardless of those peers’ underlying ability, while exposure to high-ability peers without a scholarship signal has no detectable effect. These results suggest that students respond more strongly to observable signals of academic standing than to peers’ underlying academic preparation. Taken together, our findings indicate that the sources of academic influence evolve over time.
35728.zh_abstract: 本研究考察，当学生进入新的社会环境并接触到公开可观察的学术能力信号时，学术表现的社会影响在向大学过渡期间如何演变。利用乌干达一所大型、精英且语言和文化高度异质的公立大学的行政数据，并利用学生被随机分配到宿舍这一机制，我们考察接触同族同龄人和具有奖学金身份的同龄人如何影响学术表现。我们发现，更多接触来自相似语言和文化背景的同龄人，会改善大学早期的学业成绩，但这些效应随时间消退。相比之下，接触奖学金同龄人会产生持续的学业表现收益，且其幅度随时间增加。我们的场景使我们能够区分同龄人的潜在学术能力与公开可观察的能力信号，因为奖学金身份可见，而潜在学术准备不可见。我们发现，接触奖学金同龄人会改善学业表现，无论这些同龄人的潜在能力如何；而接触没有奖学金信号的高能力同龄人则没有可检测的影响。这些结果表明，学生对可观察的学术地位信号的反应，强于对同龄人潜在学术准备的反应。综合来看，我们的发现表明，学术影响的来源随时间演变。

35727.title: Measuring Racial Disparities in Police Stops: Evidence from Telemetric Mobility Data

35727.abstract: We establish a reliable counterfactual for evaluating racial disparities in traffic stops using telemetric data to estimate the racial composition of motorists. We measure of motorist racial composition using telemetric mobility data and a novel two-stage correction methodology anchored by an independent measure, racial composition of motorists involved in accidents. Applying this to Massachusetts State Police stops, we find non-White motorists are stopped at rates exceeding their roadway presence by 6.7 percentage points. We demonstrate that uncalibrated telemetric data significantly understates minority presence (15.2 vs. 28 percent), and the uncalibrated telemetric data yields disparities that are over twice the size of our preferred estimates. We use this validated measure to assess the accuracy of several commonly-used disparity tests. We find that the widely used “Community Standard” test dramatically overestimates disparities, even when restricting to local roads or non-commuting hours. In contrast, the less-often used “Crash Benchmark” accurately captures disparities even when aggregated to higher temporal levels covering up to 94 percent of stops. Finally, the “Veil of Darkness” test yields smaller estimates than our telemetric measure, consistent with its focus on disparate treatment rather than the broader legal standard of motorist composition.

35726.title: Racial Dynamics of Federal Property Buyouts in Flood-Prone Areas
35726.zh_title: 洪水易发地区联邦财产回购中的种族动态
35726.authors: Kay Jowers, Lala Ma, Christopher D. Timmins
35726.zh_abstract_excerpt: 随着洪水风险增加，作为适应对策，对洪水易发财产进行管理性撤退或“回购”的使用可能会增加。本文研究了种族和族裔在回购议价结果中的作用，以及这些结果如何影响更长期的邻里变化。我们结合全国性的联邦财产收购行政数据、住房销售交易数据以及限制使用的人口普查微观数据，来估计回购支付相对于财产公平市场价值是否存在系统性的种族差异。然后，我们使用一个追踪个人随时间迁移的数据库，考察参与者迁入社区的质量，以及邻里结果如何因种族和项目参与情况而异。
35726.abstract: The use of managed retreats, or “buyouts,” of flood-prone properties is likely to grow as an adaptation response to increasing flood risks. This paper investigates the role of race and ethnicity in buyout bargaining outcomes and how those outcomes affect longer-run neighborhood change. We combine nationwide administrative data on federal property acquisitions, housing sales transactions, and restricted-use Census microdata to estimate whether there are systematic differences by race in buyout payments relative to a property’s fair market value. We then use a database tracking individual movement over time to examine the quality of the neighborhoods to which participants move and how neighborhood outcomes vary by race and program participation. We find that the buyout compensation received by households of color is at least 6 percent lower than that received by white households. White participants relocate to higher quality neighborhoods and are better off than white nonparticipants. Black participants, on the other hand, move to worse neighborhoods and are worse off than Black non-participants. Our work highlights how government policy, aimed to address increasing climate impacts, may exacerbate the burden of climate change on vulnerable communities.

35725.title: How Disability Benefits in Early Life Affect Adult Outcomes
35725.zh_title: 生命早期残疾福利如何影响成年结果
35725.authors: Manasi Deshpande, Alessandra Voena, Jason B. Weitze
35725.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们利用多种变异来源，估计儿童期领取补充保障收入（SSI）对成年结果的影响。利用两个准实验之间和内部的变异，我们发现该项目的效果具有异质性，并随父母对SSI福利的 earnings 反应而变化：当父母不因SSI收入调整劳动供给时（意味着家庭收入增加），该项目对儿童产生正向影响；但当父母通过减少 earnings 来抵消转移支付时（意味着家庭收入保持不变或下降），该项目对儿童的影响为零或为负。
35725.abstract: We estimate the effect of receiving Supplemental Security Income (SSI) in childhood on adult outcomes using multiple sources of variation. Using variation across and within two quasi-experiments, we find that the program has heterogeneous effects that vary with the parental earnings response to SSI benefits: the program has positive effects on children when parents do not adjust their labor supply in response to SSI income (meaning household income increases), but zero or negative effects on children when parents offset the transfer by reducing earnings (meaning household income remains constant or falls). These results suggest that, relative to parent non-work time, income is crucial in the human capital production of low-income children with disabilities. We estimate a model of maternal labor supply and child human capital formation to quantify the relative importance of these channels. Our findings indicate that 1) the income effects of SSI on children's human capital are substantial, with a limited role for perverse incentive effects from conditioning benefits on disability status, and 2) parental work on net improves children's outcomes by increasing household resources, despite the potential decrease in parental time.
35725.zh_abstract: 我们利用多种变异来源，估计儿童期领取补充保障收入（SSI）对成年结果的影响。利用两个准实验之间和内部的变异，我们发现该项目的效果具有异质性，并随父母对SSI福利的 earnings 反应而变化：当父母不因SSI收入调整劳动供给时（意味着家庭收入增加），该项目对儿童产生正向影响；但当父母通过减少 earnings 来抵消转移支付时（意味着家庭收入保持不变或下降），该项目对儿童的影响为零或为负。这些结果表明，相对于父母的非工作时间，收入对于低收入残疾儿童的人力资本生产至关重要。我们估计了一个母亲劳动供给和儿童人力资本形成模型，以量化这些渠道的相对重要性。我们的发现表明：1）SSI对儿童人力资本的收入效应相当大，而将福利与残疾身份挂钩所带来的逆向激励效应作用有限；2）父母工作总体上通过增加家庭资源改善了儿童结果，尽管父母时间可能减少。
